title: Entitled Drunk Girl Has Extreme Meltdown After Wild Night
description:
A New Jersey woman was arrested after a wild night at a bar in Belmar, New Jersey. According to the Belmar Police Department, officers responded to the Djais Bar and Grill around 9 p.m. to help staff escort out other unruly guests, but as they were doing that police could be heard saying “We got another one,” as Jenna Gutcho Allegedly tried to duck under a divider and make her way into the bar despite security not allowing her in. But when police confronted Jenna and asked her to leave, she didn’t exactly go as easily as the other patrons and ended up behind bars with multiple charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
